_comment: Official Trial A enquiry samples (WCC-TRIAL-A) from docs/WCC_Trial_A_Enquiry_Samples.md, issued 3 August 2026. IDs E01–E15 and enquiry wording must remain identical to the source. Used as the primary 15×3 harness dataset (evaluation/fixtures/enquiries.json).

enquiries.text: Hello, my name is Daniel Okafor. I am based in Manchester in the UK and I have been reading about cask ownership for a few months now. I am looking to commit around GBP 40,000 to a first purchase, ideally a Speyside cask with some age on it already. I would like to move on this within the next few weeks. You can reach me on daniel.okafor@example.com or on 07700 900412.

Hi there, saw your article on ex-bourbon barrels. Interested in learning more. I'm in Sydney. Budget is flexible but probably around 80k Australian to start. Call me on +61 2 5550 0198, I'm around most afternoons. Cheers, Marianne Fletcher.

Good afternoon. I am Hiroshi Tanaka, writing from Tokyo. A colleague recommended your firm. I am considering an allocation in the region of USD 300,000 across two or three casks, with a preference for Islay. Please contact me at h.tanaka@example.co.jp at your convenience. I am in no particular hurry and would like to understand the market properly first.
hi i want buy whisky cask. how much? i am from malaysia. my number 60 12 555 0143. name is Faizal.

Dear Sir or Madam, I hope this finds you well. I have spent the better part of the last year reading everything I can find about maturing spirit as an asset, having previously held property and a small amount of gold, neither of which I found especially satisfying to own in any tangible sense. My brother in law purchased a cask through another broker about eighteen months ago and has been insufferable about it ever since, which I suppose is what has finally prompted me to write. He paid somewhere around twenty five thousand pounds for his, a Glengoyne I believe, and I would be looking at something broadly comparable, perhaps a little more if the right thing came along. I am in Edinburgh. My email is g.mcallister@example.com. There is no great rush on my end. Kind regards, Gordon McAllister.

Hello, I'm Priya Raghavan. I'm currently in Singapore though I'm a British passport holder. I'd like to put SGD 120,000 into casks this quarter. My daughter is getting married in October and I want this settled well before then so I can stop thinking about it. Reach me at +65 8555 0177 or praghavan@example.com.

Hi, my wife and I have been talking about this for a while. She's more cautious than I am so we'd start small, maybe eight or nine thousand US. We're in Toronto. I'm Michael Brennan, she's Claire. Best email for us is m.brennan@example.com. No timeline really, just exploring.

Hello. I'm not looking to spend more than fifteen thousand pounds, I want to be clear about that up front as I've had brokers try to talk me upward before. That said, the sixty thousand pound Macallan you featured last month did look extremely good and I would want to hear about anything similar. I'm in Bristol. Andrew Pike, apike@example.com, 07700 900733.

Good day, I would like information on cask investment please. I can be reached on +971 4 555 0122. I am ready to proceed quickly, ideally this month. Budget in the region of 150,000 US dollars. Regards, Yusuf Al-Rashid.

Hi, everyone calls me Bob but my documents all say Robert Sinclair so I assume you'll want the latter. I'm in Wellington, New Zealand. Looking at maybe NZD 30,000 for a first cask, whisky rather than anything else, and I'd want to have it done before the end of the year. bob.sinclair@example.co.nz is the address I actually check.

To whom it may concern, I read your piece on independent bottling with interest. I have a portfolio of fine wine already and am considering diversifying. I would want to start meaningfully, in the low six figures, and would also want to understand the tequila side you mentioned. Please write to me. Yours, J.W.

jw.correspondence@example.com

Hello I am wanting to know about the whisky. My friend told me it is good investment. I do not know much. I am in Bangkok Thailand. Maybe I can spend 200000 baht but I am not sure. Please explain to me. Somchai P. Line and WhatsApp same number +66 8 5550 0166.

Morning. Elena Volkova here, calling from Limassol. I want to move fast on this, ideally within the fortnight, as I have funds sitting idle from a property completion. Two hundred and fifty thousand euros, possibly more. Springbank if you have anything, otherwise Islay. +357 25 555 0109.

Hi, I filled in the form on your site last week and nobody got back to me. Trying again. Thomas Lindqvist, Stockholm. I'd said around USD 20,000 for an oloroso butt if you have one. Getting a bit frustrated honestly, if I don't hear back this time I'll go elsewhere. thomas.lindqvist@example.se
